# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/pipx
# args: 
usage: pipx list [-h] [--quiet] [--verbose] [--skip-maintenance] [--global]
                 [--include-injected] [--outdated] [--short | --pinned]
                 [--output {human,json} | --json]
                 [packages ...]

List packages and apps installed with pipx

positional arguments:
  packages              Installed packages to list

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --quiet, -q           Give less output. May be used multiple times
                        corresponding to the ERROR and CRITICAL logging
                        levels. The count maxes out at 2.
  --verbose, -v         Give more output. May be used multiple times
                        corresponding to the INFO, DEBUG and NOTSET logging
                        levels. The count maxes out at 3.
  --skip-maintenance    Do not upgrade shared libraries; use bundled pip when
                        creating them.
  --global              Perform action globally for all users.
  --include-injected    Show packages injected into the main app's environment
  --outdated            List packages with an available upgrade.
  --short               List packages only.
  --pinned              List pinned packages only. Pass --include-injected at
                        the same time to list injected packages that were
                        pinned.
  --output {human,json}
                        Select the output format.
  --json                Print the installed-package snapshot as JSON, the
                        format install-all consumes.
